_about: Performance targets checked by sla-gate.js after a run. p95Ms: 95th-percentile response time per sampler label (ms); 'default' applies to every label not listed. Per-sample hard ceilings live in the .jmx (Duration Assertions: maxResponseMs / maxReportMs).

smoke._about: Functional sanity: every request must succeed. Latency is not judged (1 user, possible cold start).

load._about: The SLA run: at expected concurrency every label must meet its p95 and the error rate must stay under 1 %.

stress._about: Informational: finds the breaking point (first time window over the error or p95 limit). Never fails the build.

spike._about: Survive and recover: limited errors during the burst, and after it p95 must return to within maxRecoveryP95Ratio of baseline.
